name: @projekt-manga/desktop
description: Electron shell for ProjektManga — loads the Next.js web app and provides OS-only capabilities (currently: revealing a download folder) through a preload bridge.
author: Mystyvyy

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run stage && node scripts/prepare-installer-script.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:fast: npm run build && npm run stage && node scripts/prepare-installer-script.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
